noPlan.decisiveGap: No CDL school is shown paying for an ELDT audit-readiness review (or either alternative) at the planned price, no close rate exists, and the current number of reachable registered providers is not established (the registry figures are a December 2025 sweep and later removals): whether at least 7 TPR-listed schools will pay $750 and the cash is collected by day 30 decides whether any plan exists (OFFER_AND_PRICE, CONVERSION, MARKET_VOLUME).
noPlan.resolution: Costed experiment, $0 of the $1,000 and about 10 owner hours: Brain compiles 150 currently registered TPR providers with public contacts (also counting how many are listed); owner offers a $750 prepaid ELDT audit-readiness file review on day 2 and delivers the first one to time it. PROOF (day 10): at least 3 paid invoices from 150 (2%, which over 450 contacts gives ~9 >= 7 needed), the first review delivered in <= 6 owner hours, and the owner confirms ~45 hours -> CONTINUE to 300 more providers to collect 7 paid reviews by day 25; sales after day 25 count only if collected (paid by card/Stripe invoice) by day 30. STOP: no paid invoice and fewer than 5 interested replies by day 10 -> stop and report the target not reachable in this industry in 30 days. CONTINUE-ONCE: interest but fewer than 3 paid -> offer $395 to 100 more providers; since $395 needs 13 sales ($5,135), proceed only if >= 3 of those 100 pay (3%, ~13 from 450), else stop on day 15.

answers.finding: 7 sales needed at $750; $0 spend; capital cap respected.
answers.resolution: Agreed: 7 sales at $750, $0 spend, inside the $1,000 cap.

answers.finding: Proof miscalibrated: 2/150 -> 6 total from 450 contacts, short of 7.
answers.resolution: Accepted: proof raised to >= 3 paid of 150 (2%), which yields ~9 from 450 contacts, above the 7 needed.

answers.finding: $395 fallback needs 13 sales - its threshold should be derived from that.
answers.resolution: Accepted: the $395 fallback threshold is now derived from 13 sales: >= 3 paid of 100 (3%), else stop.

answers.finding: Owner hours 28-42 h of delivery plus outreach, against unstated owner hours - ask or state as an unknown the test must measure (it does time the first review, good).
answers.resolution: Accepted: owner hours are an unknown the owner must confirm (~45 h); added step t5 and quantity q_owner_hours_total; the test still times the first review.

answers.finding: Decisive links OFFER_AND_PRICE and CONVERSION are correctly the live-test unknowns; MARKET_VOLUME on the review opening also remains unestablished (the registry counts I verified are a Dec-2025 sweep and removals, not current buyers) and should be listed.
answers.resolution: Accepted: MARKET_VOLUME added to decisiveLinks and resolves; the test counts currently registered reachable providers.
Metric is COLLECTED_CASH; sales after ~day 25 count only if collected by day 30, now stated in the resolution.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN with a costed test is the right shape: no CDL school is shown paying for any of the three offers (I verified the ECO hourly rate and PTDI kit list price as other sellers' prices for different offers), and no close rate exists. Recomputed: $5,000 / $750 = 6.67 -> 7 paid reviews, $0 direct cost, inside the $1,000 cap. But the CONTINUE threshold does not imply the target: '>= 2 paid of 150 by day 10' is a 1.3% rate, and 300 more contacts at that rate yield 4 more - 6 in total, $4,500 < $5,000. The proof should be >= 3 paid of 150 (2%, giving ~9 from 450) or the continuation should contact ~375+ more. The CONTINUE-ONCE at $395 needs 13 sales ($5,135), i.e. a far higher rate, and should say so. Owner hours are unstated (unknown, not zero): 150-450 owner emails/calls plus 7 reviews at 4-6 h (28-42 h) must be named as a requirement the owner confirms. Stripe's first payout (7-14 days per the d03/d01 record) is irrelevant only because the metric is COLLECTED_CASH - state that sales after day ~25 still count only if collected by day 30.
findings: 7 sales needed at $750; $0 spend; capital cap respected.
Proof miscalibrated: 2/150 -> 6 total from 450 contacts, short of 7.
$395 fallback needs 13 sales - its threshold should be derived from that.
Owner hours 28-42 h of delivery plus outreach, against unstated owner hours - ask or state as an unknown the test must measure (it does time the first review, good).

Decisive links OFFER_AND_PRICE and CONVERSION are correctly the live-test unknowns; MARKET_VOLUME on the review opening also remains unestablished (the registry counts I verified are a Dec-2025 sweep and removals, not current buyers) and should be listed.

reviews.reasons: My findings are resolved. NO_PLAN with a costed $0 test is right: no CDL school is shown paying for any of the three offers, no close rate exists, and the current reachable provider count is unestablished (now in decisiveLinks). Recomputed: 7 x $750 = $5,250 >= $5,000; proof >= 3 paid of 150 (2%) gives ~9 from 450 contacts; the $395 fallback needs 13 sales ($5,135) and its >= 3% threshold gives ~13.5 from 450; spend $0 inside the $1,000 cap; collection by day 30 is stated for the COLLECTED_CASH metric; owner hours (~45 h) are asked of the owner before continuing rather than assumed.
findings: Thresholds derived from the target and consistent.
Owner time is an explicit confirmation step (t5) - good.
If the $395 fallback is entered, 250 of the 450 contacts are already used at other terms; the ~13 from 450 projection is slightly optimistic - hold the day-15 stop.
